title: Case 040: Confirmation of a Specific Payment
initial_request: I need a copy of the bank record for my £74.00 payment to a repair contractor, so I can share evidence of the payment with them. I can see the transaction in my secure portal, but need a document showing its current stage.
overview: Mara Ellison asked H&V for a record of a specific outgoing payment after finding it in her secure portal transaction history. The agent selected that operation for document generation, and H&V made the resulting payment record available to Mara in the secure portal. The record shows the payment as sent; whether it has been credited to the recipient remains unconfirmed.

next_action.summary: The agent’s immediate step was to select payment HV-040 in the document service and request a record for that operation.

outcome: The secure portal provided payment-record-040.pdf for payment HV-040, dated 14 July 2025, for £74.00, with bank status SENT. The record does not confirm credit to the recipient; acknowledgment of payment by the recipient remains open.

events.body: I show an outgoing payment of £74.00 dated 14 July 2025 in your transaction history. Its reference is HV-040 and its bank status is SENT.

I need a record for this particular payment to give my repair contractor. I can see HV-040 in my history, but I need a document showing its stage; I understand that the contractor’s confirmation of receipt is separate.
I matched the customer’s request to payment HV-040 in the authenticated secure-portal session. Please generate the payment record for this operation for delivery to the customer’s secure portal.
Record HV-040 generated for the payment dated 14 July 2025, amount £74.00. The bank status on the record is SENT.
I’ve made payment-record-040.pdf available in your secure portal for payment HV-040. It records the £74.00 payment dated 14 July 2025 as SENT and does not confirm credit to the recipient.

attachments.name: payment-record-040.pdf
attachments.text:
